title: Use Your Storm To Rest
text: [Music] you know i used to wonder why god identified himself at only two animals and the lion and the eagle last year i spoke on the lion you remember that but the eagle is a strange bird the eagle is the only bird in the bird kingdom who watches for storms it's incredible every other bird scatters and a storm is coming the eagle is the only bird that flies toward the storm god says i will bear you up like an eagle why do eagles fly into storms because the eagles have a little bone in their wing a small little extra bone is called the pinion the pinion the eagle only uses it when it wants to rest [Laughter] so the eagle looks at the storm and he says it's time to rest he flies toward the storm into the storm and he locks his wings oh come on and the wind of the storm lifts him high above the storm and he uses the storm to rest the day has arrived you
